aim: Compare complete evidence-learning revision; no component causal attribution.
rationale: Two cells isolate the complete revision with identical visible Solver interface. Four cells would require extra partial-policy runtimes and more API budget; component effects remain unidentified.

common.mutation_membership: same selected-support seed policy where compatible; explicit overlap difference is treatment

freeze_requirements: new matched initial Optimize realizations (22/60 not reused)
exact source and per-cell binding/manifest hashes
exact selected opportunity memberships persisted before generation
one independent Gradient diagnostic per wrong example in B; historical recovery in A explicitly identified
fresh per-cell authorization/cache namespace/accounting; paired identical inference requests share a governed realization identity
separate role resource derivation and token pre-admission; no efficacy-based stopping
no Validation/Test or old authorization reuse
limitations: one seed and five opportunities are diagnostic only
bundle comparison cannot identify each component effect
token ceiling may produce an incomplete prefix; do not classify incomplete results as efficacy
